title: hoshidicts ka test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Georgian dictionary for languages/ka/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack (GPL-3.0-or-later). Most lemma rows carry a part of speech in the rules column; ფანჯარა, ხატავს, ლამაზი and მას have none, as every row of wty-ka-en, and the form-of rows have none, as wiktionary-to-yomitan writes them.
